description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 28.12.2020 to 03.01.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns regulatory matters under the Customs Ordinance. It announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework update. The content involves legal/statutory instruments (Customs Ordinance Chapter 235) and compliance requirements for customs payments, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (Director General of Customs), this is incidental to the regulatory nature of the content, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or structural government changes that would make it a government-related type.
